entities.name: Aylith
entities.description: Daughter of Logan, seventh Keeper of Inys Haen in Haen's line, who mended the Clan Tree of Cridhe.

entities.name: Logan
entities.description: Keeper of Inys Haen and Aylith's father; died in the fire after passing on the Memories.

entities.name: Haen the First
entities.description: Ancestor of Aylith and first of the Keeper line.

entities.name: Inys Haen
entities.description: Village of the Keepers, burned by Nohrish raiders.

entities.name: Inys Nohr
entities.description: Nohrish city to which Aylith was taken.

entities.name: Thix
entities.description: Kinsman to the Felonarch who set Inys Haen ablaze; slain by RoNal.

entities.name: RoNal
entities.description: Leader of the Nohrish force who adopted Aylith and sacrificed himself to the Frog.

entities.name: Jedhian
entities.description: Aylith's cousin who followed and tried to rescue her.

entities.name: Lorris
entities.description: RoNal's daughter who formed an uneasy bond with Aylith.

entities.name: Nazir
entities.description: Felonarch of Inys Nohr who struck down Aylith with Soulslayer and was later healed by her of his family's curse.

entities.name: Feryar
entities.description: Elf in Nazir's service who carried Aylith away in owl form.

entities.name: The Frog
entities.description: Monstrous creature in the pit beneath the castle.

entities.name: Mirkalbions
entities.description: Nocturnal slaves reliant on ardré fungus, granted refuge in Loch Prith.

entities.name: Loch Prith
entities.description: Hidden elven sanctuary where Aylith was healed.

entities.name: Far Clans
entities.description: Clans who allied with Aylith's side.

entities.name: Clan Tree of Cridhe
entities.description: Tree whose Memories the Keepers carry; mended by Aylith.

entities.name: Soulslayer
entities.description: Weapon with which Nazir struck down Aylith.

entities.name: Mending of the Clan Tree
entities.description: Event restoring light, life and balance via a new sapling Clan Tree.

events.summary: Aylith is not made heir to her father's Memories because she is female.
events.quote: Aylith was not made the heir to her father Logan 's Memories because she was female

events.summary: Nohrish raiders attack Inys Haen; Thix sets it ablaze, Logan passes on the Memories to Aylith and dies.
events.quote: The Keeper was able to pass on the Memories of the Clan Tree, making his daughter a Keeper herself

events.summary: RoNal slays Thix and adopts Aylith.
events.quote: RoNal , leader of the Nohrish force, slew Thix

events.summary: In Inys Nohr, Nazir enchants Aylith into revealing the Memories; Feryar shows her the last branch of the Tree.
events.quote: enchanted her into revealing that she carried the Memories of the Clan Tree

events.summary: RoNal sacrifices himself to the Frog so Jedhian can escape.
Nazir strikes Aylith down with Soulslayer; Feryar carries her away.
events.quote: Nazir struck her down with Soulslayer

events.summary: Healed at Loch Prith, Aylith overcomes her inner darkness.
events.quote: she confronted her inner darkness and overcame it

events.summary: Aylith chooses peace over vengeance and heals Nazir of his family's curse.
events.quote: healed him of his family's curse

events.summary: Aylith and Nazir recite the Awakening Ritual, causing the Mending of the Clan Tree and ending the fighting.
events.quote: a new sapling Clan Tree took root, restoring balance to the plane

relations.quote: was the daughter and only child of Logan
slew Thix when he attempted to rape the unconscious Aylith
Nazir struck her down with Soulslayer
Feryar, in owl form, carried her unconscious body away
Aylith's cousin Jedhian followed closely behind
